result.title: Uncertainty-Aware Prototype Learning for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation
result.summary: Open-set test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt source-trained models to unlabeled test streams where covariate-shifted in-distribution (csID) samples and covariate-shifted out-of-distribution (csOOD) samples may coexist. Existing TTA methods are typically designed under a closed-set assumption and therefore lack explicit mechanisms for reliably distinguishing csID from csOOD samples. Consequently, csOOD samples may be mistakenly included in confidence-enhancing adaptation, producing harmful gradients that degrade known-class performance. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Prototype Learning for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation (UAPA), a plug-and-play method for reliable open-set adaptation. Specifically, we first introduce Uncertainty-Driven ID/OOD Separation, which combines a classifier-prototype score with a mini-batch-normalized evidence-derived uncertainty score to distinguish csID from csOOD samples. We then propose a Dynamic Prototype Refinement strategy that periodically refines class-specific target prototypes using buffered csID features to progressively follow the estimated class directions. Lastly, we introduce Contrastive Prototype Entropy Adaptation, which applies entropy minimization to csID samples and entropy maximization to csOOD samples, while prototype-level contrastive learning aligns csID features with their corresponding target prototypes and reduces the maximum similarity between csOOD features and known-class prototypes. Empirically, UAPA outperforms the strongest baselines on the CIFAR benchmarks and Tiny-ImageNet-C, improving average OSCR by 2.08 and 1.28 percentage points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UAPA 开集测试时自适应方法：用分类器-原型得分与基于证据、批内归一化的不确定性得分分离 csID 与 csOOD 样本，动态精化目标类原型，并对两类样本分别做熵最小化/最大化与原型级对比学习，以抑制有害梯度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「原型相似度＋不确定性」的门控筛选思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、以及决定是否用新证据更新推理状态提供借鉴；但该文是单图分类的 TTA，不含推理状态或生成过程，联系较远，需核查。
